title: Sheaves of modules on a scheme have enough injectives
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules on the underlying topological space of $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ has enough injectives: every $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ admits a monomorphism $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I$ into an injective object $\mathcal I$ of $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. (Stacks states and proves this for an arbitrary ringed space, with functorial injective embeddings.)

source.place: Injectives, Lemma 01DI (lemma-sheaves-modules-space); used in Cohomology of Sheaves, Section 01EO (literature/stacks-project/cohomology.tex, the paragraph defining $H^i(X,\mathcal F)$ by an injective resolution)
